fixed.summary: Each frame `og render` draws waits, natively, until the textures being prepared are, so a model loaded with og.load.gltf (or a scene) is drawn with its maps on the first frame instead of hidden for as long as the texture worker took, and two renders of one script draw the same frames. A display frame, and an `og run --commands` frame, still never waits; a stream group's model still waits for its group.
